$comment: Deterministic intake -> clients/<slug>.json mapping for google-ads-agent. The /create-google-ads-agent skill collects the Shot A intake (SKILL.md Step 1, Tier 1 + Tier 2) as FLAT answers into answers.json; scripts/build-config.mjs maps them through these entries onto intake.base.json, fail-closed. The LLM transcribes flat values only — it NEVER hand-writes nested config JSON, and it never writes acceptance.criteria by hand (the default below is the vertical's real criteria set, every code id backed by a check in scripts/verify-acceptance.registry.mjs). answers.json stays on disk as the audit artifact: what the human actually said, diffable against what shipped. The 3 campaign *_id fields are deliberately absent — bootstrap creates the campaigns PAUSED and writes the numeric ids back; intake.base.json carries their placeholders.

entries.question: Client slug (lowercase a-z, 0-9, - or _)? Becomes the folder name and the engine's --client key.
Client display / brand name (used in run logs and the dashboard)?
Google Ads customer id of the account being managed (digits; dashes OK)?
login-customer-id: from the Admin -> Access and security -> Managers tab. Empty Managers tab = direct account, so repeat the customer id. A manager listed = that manager's 10-digit id.
Name for the broad-match discovery campaign (default graphed_testing)?
Name for the exact-match Winners campaign (default graphed_winners)?
target_cpa: max cost-per-conversion for a converting term to qualify as a Winner. No conversion tracking yet? Derive a PROVISIONAL ceiling (existing CPC / expected CVR) and say so.
waste_min_spend: spend at zero conversions before a term is negated (default 10).
lookback_days: GAQL window for winners/waste/prune (default 30).
prune_min_spend: Winners-prune spend floor — never negate a served term below this spend (default 10, mirrors waste_min_spend; the missing prune floor is what broke Conduit).
prune_require_zero_conversions: never negate a term that converted in the lookback? (default yes — the Conduit guard; only turn off with a human ruling)
max_negatives_per_run: cap on new negatives per prune run (default 25, highest demonstrated waste first).
Final URL for the RSA created when a winner is promoted?
Brand headline woven into the RSA (headline 3)?
RSA description lines — at least 2 (Google requires 2+). Comma-separated or a JSON array.
BROAD-match seed keywords: layer (a) the account's existing proven terms, (b) product-core terms, (c) the vertical fan-out. Comma-separated or a JSON array.
PHRASE-match seed keywords (the tightest-intent core terms). Optional.
Campaign-level BROAD negatives (job-hunt / education / freebie-tool intent). Do NOT negate 'free' for a free-signup product. Optional.
bootstrap.daily_budget: daily budget in account currency, applied to BOTH campaigns at creation (default 50).
bootstrap.bidding: MAXIMIZE_CLICKS (safe default, needs no conversion history) or MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS.
safety.default_validate_only — stays true (writes are dry-run unless --apply). Confirm, don't invent.
safety.require_apply_flag — stays true (real writes require an explicit --apply). Confirm, don't invent.
Dashboard page title (optional; defaults to '<display_name> Google Ads').
Dashboard logo-badge initials, 1-3 chars (optional).
Dashboard primary brand color as #rrggbb (optional).
Dashboard accent brand color as #rrggbb (optional).
What condition must become true for this agent to be done?
entries.default: `node scripts/verify-agent.mjs <agent-dir> --runs runs/<client>/<stamp>` exits 0 and every configured acceptance criterion is PASS or PARKED with evidence

entries.question: How many fix->rerun-verify attempts before the goal loop stops and reports FAIL? (default 3)

Acceptance criteria (JSON array). The default below IS this vertical's criteria set: five code criteria, each backed by a registered check in scripts/verify-acceptance.registry.mjs and by a negative case in template/google-ads-agent/fixtures/runs-bad/, plus two human criteria PARKED at gate 'reviewer'. Only change it with a human in the loop — an id with no registered check FAILS closed.

default.description: Every row in the run's winners.json satisfies the configured Winner rule: conversions > 0 AND costPerConversion <= thresholds.target_cpa. A term that did not earn its way in is not a winner.
default.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/winners.json carries a row at costPerConversion 213.5 (> target_cpa 75) -> FAIL

default.description: Every row in the run's waste.json satisfies the configured waste rule: conversions absent-or-0 AND cost > thresholds.waste_min_spend. Nothing gets negated for spending less than the floor.
default.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/waste.json carries a row at cost 4.2 (<= waste_min_spend 10) -> FAIL

default.description: Every converting winner reconciles: costPerConversion equals cost / conversions within the configured envelope. Catches a fabricated cost figure that no GAQL row backs.
default.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/winners.json claims costPerConversion 12 on cost 180 / 3 conversions (= 60) -> FAIL

default.description: summary.json's promotionsApplied / wasteApplied / pruneApplied are all false unless a non-empty human approval artifact (approved-promotions.json / approved-waste-negatives.json) exists in the same run. No write without a human behind it.
default.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/summary.json sets promotionsApplied+wasteApplied true with no approval files in the run -> FAIL

default.description: summary.json cannot claim numbers its own artifacts do not back: winnersFound === winners.json row count and wasteTermsFound === waste.json row count.
default.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/summary.json reports winnersFound 2 while winners.json holds 3 rows -> FAIL

default.description: The Conduit lesson (FDE-303), enforced in code: every NEGATE decision in prune.json has conversions 0 (unless prune_hard_cpa_cap re-exposes a runaway converter), spend >= thresholds.prune_min_spend, is never the ad group's target keyword, and the total NEGATE count is <= thresholds.max_negatives_per_run. Every decision carries a reason code. A prune.json without per-term decisions cannot prove the guards ran and FAILS.
default.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/prune.json NEGATEs 'hvac financing for contractors' with 3 conversions and spend 2.1 (< prune_min_spend 10) — the exact shape that strangled Conduit's delivery -> FAIL

default.description: A human confirms the discovered winner search terms are on-brand and worth promoting BEFORE any promotion is applied.
default.verification: Reviewer signs off runs/<client>/<stamp>/winners.json; approved rows are handed back as --approved-winners and recorded in approved-promotions.json.

default.description: A human confirms the proposed waste negatives will not block legitimate traffic BEFORE they are added to the Testing campaign.
default.verification: Reviewer signs off runs/<client>/<stamp>/waste.json; approved terms are handed back as --approved-waste-terms and recorded in approved-waste-negatives.json.
